points.title: Supported read beat returned OKAY
points.condition: R handshake of a supported read transaction with RRESP=OKAY.

points.title: Supported read beat returned SLVERR from PSLVERR
points.condition: R handshake of a supported read transaction with RRESP=SLVERR.

points.title: Unsupported read beat returned SLVERR
points.condition: R handshake of an unsupported read transaction with RRESP=SLVERR.

points.title: Supported write completes with B OKAY
points.condition: B handshake of a supported write with BRESP=OKAY.

points.title: Supported write completes with B SLVERR
points.condition: B handshake of a supported write with BRESP=SLVERR.

points.title: Unsupported write completes with one SLVERR B
points.condition: B handshake of an unsupported write with BRESP=SLVERR.

points.title: Read FIXED burst of 16 beats completes
points.condition: Final R handshake of a supported FIXED read with ARLEN=15.

points.title: Write FIXED burst of 16 beats completes
points.condition: B handshake of a supported FIXED write with AWLEN=15.

points.title: Read INCR burst of 256 beats completes
points.condition: Final R handshake of a supported INCR read with ARLEN=255.

points.title: Write INCR burst of 256 beats completes
points.condition: B handshake of a supported INCR write with AWLEN=255.

points.title: Read WRAP burst of 16 beats completes
points.condition: Final R handshake of a supported WRAP read with ARLEN=15.

points.title: Write WRAP burst of 16 beats completes
points.condition: B handshake of a supported WRAP write with AWLEN=15.

points.title: Minimum WRAP burst of 2 beats completes
points.condition: Completion (final R or B) of a supported WRAP transaction with length 2 beats.

points.title: Single-beat INCR transaction completes
points.condition: Completion (final R or B) of a supported INCR transaction with length 1 beat.

points.title: Byte transfer with unaligned start address on APB
points.condition: APB transfer completes in a transaction with AxSIZE=0 and AxADDR[1:0] not zero.

points.title: Halfword write on upper lanes with PSTRB 1100
points.condition: APB write completes in a size-1 transaction starting at AxADDR[1]=1 with PSTRB=4'b1100.

points.title: Word transfer with unaligned start address
points.condition: APB transfer completes in a transaction with AxSIZE=2 and AxADDR[1:0] not zero.

points.title: Aligned word write with full strobes
points.condition: APB write completes in a size-2 transaction with PSTRB=4'b1111.

points.title: Write beat with zero byte strobes
points.condition: APB write completes with PSTRB=4'b0000.

points.title: Read request with unsupported size or reserved burst accepted
points.condition: AR handshake with ARSIZE greater than 2 or ARBURST=2'b11.

points.title: Write request with unsupported size or reserved burst accepted
points.condition: AW handshake with AWSIZE greater than 2 or AWBURST=2'b11.

points.title: Request with illegal cache value accepted
points.condition: AR or AW handshake with AxCACHE other than 0000 and 0001.

points.title: INCR burst crossing a 4-KiB boundary accepted
points.condition: AR or AW handshake of an INCR burst whose aligned start offset plus total bytes exceeds 4096.

points.title: Illegal FIXED or WRAP length accepted
points.condition: AR or AW handshake of a FIXED burst longer than 16 beats or a WRAP burst whose length is not 2, 4, 8 or 16.

points.title: INCR burst ending exactly at 4-KiB boundary is supported
points.condition: AR or AW handshake of an otherwise legal INCR burst whose aligned start offset plus total bytes equals exactly 4096.

points.title: RREADY backpressure for 3 or more cycles
points.condition: RVALID high with RREADY low for a third or later consecutive cycle.

points.title: BREADY backpressure for 3 or more cycles
points.condition: BVALID high with BREADY low for a third or later consecutive cycle.

points.title: Request held pending while a transaction owns the bridge
points.condition: AWVALID or ARVALID high with the matching READY low while a transaction is active.

points.title: WVALID presented before AW accepted
points.condition: WVALID high while no transaction is active and no AW handshake occurs at that edge.

points.title: APB wait states of 3 or more cycles
points.condition: APB ACCESS phase with PREADY low for a third or later consecutive cycle.

points.title: Long APB wait of 32 or more cycles
points.condition: APB ACCESS phase with PREADY low after at least 32 prior consecutive wait cycles.

points.title: Write continues cleanly after an earlier PSLVERR beat
points.condition: APB write completes with PSLVERR=0 after an earlier APB write of the same transaction completed with PSLVERR=1.

points.title: Read burst continues with OKAY beat after an earlier error beat
points.condition: R handshake with RRESP=OKAY of a supported read after an earlier APB read of the same transaction completed with PSLVERR=1.

points.title: Reset applied during activity then idle after reset
points.condition: First edge after reset release, where reset was asserted while a transaction was active or APB PSEL was high, with bridge idle and PSEL, BVALID, RVALID all low.

points.title: First tie after reset won by AR
points.condition: Idle bridge accepts AR with AWVALID also high and no transaction has completed since reset.

points.title: Tie won by AW after a completed read
points.condition: Idle bridge accepts AW with ARVALID also high and the previous completed transaction was a read.

points.title: Tie won by AR after a completed write
points.condition: Idle bridge accepts AR with AWVALID also high and the previous completed transaction was a write.

points.title: Maximum ID value echoed on R or B
points.condition: R or B handshake where the response ID has all bits set.

points.title: PPROT all ones on completed APB transfer
points.condition: APB transfer completes with PPROT=3'b111.

points.title: WRAP burst address wraps back to lower boundary
points.condition: SETUP phase of a non-first APB transfer of a supported WRAP transaction where PADDR is lower than the previous transfer PADDR.
